speaker: Doctor
text: Can you tell me how long you have been experiencing this cough and shortness of breath, and does it worsen at night or with physical exertion?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had this cough and shortness of breath for about three months now. It gets noticeably worse when I climb stairs or do other physical activities, but it doesn't seem to bother me at night. However, the stroke team confirmed ischemic stroke before transfer. This session should only record the confirmed diagnosis, not re-assess.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Post-stroke dyspnea and cough secondary to aspiration pneumonia or post-stroke mobility impairment leading to atelectasis.
